finding: Sites config covers the Web project only; PocketBase, long-running workers, persistent volumes and their network boundary are not defined.
required_closure_evidence: Approved topology diagram plus target inventory and responsibility matrix.

finding: Hosted gateway preflight lacks target POCKETBASE_URL, gateway token and PocketBase server credentials; external HTTPS settings were not injected into the inspected process.
required_closure_evidence: Sanitized successful preflight from the target environment and secret-manager injection record.

finding: Renderer defaults to public/renders and returns /renders URLs while Sites has no R2 binding; durable publication and replay are not established.
required_closure_evidence: Persistent render volume or object-storage publication test with hash, replay and restore evidence.

finding: No current same-point database + PocketBase storage + render-output restore drill exists.
required_closure_evidence: attestations/backup-restore.json with manifest hashes, isolated restore, media sampling, RPO and RTO.

finding: Migration audit concludes forward-only upgrade; a real-data forward migration and whole-snapshot rollback rehearsal is absent.
required_closure_evidence: attestations/migration-rollback.json with before/after schema and count evidence.

finding: Queue observer is a point-in-time script; no scheduled metrics, thresholds or real notification delivery exists.
required_closure_evidence: attestations/monitoring-alerts.json with injected alert and recovery delivery evidence.

finding: Default material workers multiplex analysis, matching and rendering; target peak capacity and starvation behavior are unknown.
required_closure_evidence: attestations/worker-capacity.json with target-host p95, peak memory/disk and backlog recovery.

finding: Current host has about 5.4 GiB free and reports 98% filesystem use, below the proposed 20 GiB render safety gate.
required_closure_evidence: Target disk/volume capacity evidence above threshold plus low-space alert test.

finding: Worktree has 118 modified/untracked paths and is not a frozen release candidate.
required_closure_evidence: Clean frozen release SHA, reproducible build hash and reviewed change manifest.

finding: Repository is linked to a Sites project on main; no repository workflow exists, but control-plane auto-deploy and branch protection cannot be verified locally.
required_closure_evidence: attestations/deployment-policy.json proving manual production approval and branch protection.

finding: Material intake persists the input source_url; a signed query string could become long-lived PocketBase data.
required_closure_evidence: Code fix and regression proving only redacted origin/path or source identity is stored; historical signed queries are remediated.

finding: Read-only queue snapshot observed one active analysis job; no release drain/freeze evidence exists.
required_closure_evidence: Pre-release snapshot with zero queued/active/expired jobs or an approved exception list.

finding: Material intake server route targets NEXT_PUBLIC_POCKETBASE_URL directly and does not demonstrate authenticated access to the locked hosted collection.
required_closure_evidence: Hosted end-to-end intake via a server-only authenticated PocketBase path.

finding: Local PocketBase runtime database mode is 0644.
required_closure_evidence: Target runtime database and backup permissions limited to the service account/backup role.

finding: PocketBase setup downloads a fixed version over HTTPS but does not verify a pinned checksum/signature.
required_closure_evidence: Pinned trusted checksum/signature verification and failure regression test.

finding: Render validation includes an absolute local output file path in persisted diagnostics.
required_closure_evidence: Redacted diagnostics contract that exposes an artifact ID/path basename, not a host filesystem path.

finding: External-data session snapshot may temporarily retain expiring playback URLs in sessionStorage.
required_closure_evidence: Telemetry exclusion/CSP review and explicit cleanup on import/logout/expiry.

finding: npm audit reports zero production vulnerabilities, but npm ls reports extraneous installed packages.
required_closure_evidence: Clean immutable install from the frozen lockfile on the build runner.
